title: Space cancel flows use the kit Button: bookings, enrollments, ticket RSVPs and my bookings
detail:
Split from SCAN-1133 on 2026-11-23. The raw-button-bg counter is at its floor of 22 and every one of those sites is on the row's left-on-purpose list, so this slice takes raw buttons the lexical counter never saw. Four Space cancel flows hand-rolled their controls: BookingCancelButton (owner bookings list), EnrollmentCancelButton (owner enrollment list and the member enroll card), TicketRsvpCancelButton (the member ticket card) and BookingMineList (the member's own bookings: Reschedule, Cancel, Cancel booking, Keep, Close). Measured in a browser before the change: the action was a 28px outline and Keep was a bare text link 30 by 17px, on member surfaces that are used on a phone, while the membership cancel beside them was already on the kit at 36px. Now every control is the kit Button at sm (36px): ghost for the resting action, Keep and Close, secondary for Reschedule, dangerOutline for the destructive step. The destructive step uses the Button loading lock (aria-busy, disabled, label unchanged) and drops the inline spinner that changed its width. No copy, action wiring or server gate changed.

VERIFIED: a jsdom render test clicks through each flow and pins the kit classes and type=button; before and after pictures at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 in light and dark, resting and confirming, from a temporary harness page that mounted the real components inside the members kit root (the harness was not committed). NOT VERIFIED: the real signed-in pages (Space settings availability and enroll sections, the Space profile booking, tickets and enroll tabs); no signed-in session or database was available. Left alone: MembershipCancelButton, which already draws kit classes through a design switch and whose Confirm is the ink button, so the membership Confirm is ink while these four are the danger outline. Which of the two a destructive confirm should be is an owner call.

Closed 2026-11-23: the four Space cancel flows draw every control with the kit Button at the member size; the probe and the render test pass.
